settings.hero_desc: A 2-metre life size nutcracker that turns any entrance, mall or lobby into a festive landmark. Hand-built, hand-painted and lit with warm LEDs, with your logo and colours built right in. A show-stopping seasonal centrepiece guests stop to photograph.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your logo, brand colours, height and base text
settings.s1_body: Few decorations command attention like a giant nutcracker standing guard at your door. At 2 metres tall, this custom piece is built for hotels, malls, showrooms and events that want a festive centrepiece worth photographing. We paint it in your brand colours, add your logo, and install LED lighting to personalise this sculpture - a seasonal showpiece you can bring back year after year.
settings.case_heading: A Festive Landmark for the Season
settings.case_body: Commissioned as a seasonal centrepiece for a hotel entrance, this nutcracker quickly became the most-photographed spot on the property through the festive period - branded, lit, and reused the following year. We made 2 nutcrackers at the same time for Alici and IL BORRO Restaurant.
settings.case_quote: Guests lined up to take photos with it. It made our entrance feel like an festival.
settings.prov_p: The nutcracker has guarded doorways as a symbol of good luck and protection for centuries. Scaled up and lit, it becomes the perfect modern centrepiece for any festive space. The guardian of the festive season.
